response.text: The sources do not support that statement. RBI Directions explicitly prohibit banks from outsourcing core management functions, including Internal Audit, compliance function, and decision-making functions such as KYC compliance determination, loan sanction, and investment portfolio management [1]. The same prohibition applies to NBFCs [2] and SEBI-regulated intermediaries [3]. I cannot confirm the premise of your question as it contradicts the regulatory text provided.
